# Form

## Summary
Catalog (boxel-surface) form layout component: renders a model's fields as
a structured form with layout, density, and column control. Lives in the
catalog realm at `boxel-surface/src/components/form` (default export
`Form`).

## API
- `@model` / `@resolvedFields` / `@fields` — what to render (a resolved form
  model, pre-resolved field inputs, or named field components)
- `@layout` — `vertical | horizontal`; `@density` — `comfortable | compact`
- `@columns` — column spec; `@mode` — form mode; `@errors` — error strings
- `@heading`, `@description` — form chrome

## Usage
```gts
import Form from 'https://realms-staging.stack.cards/catalog/boxel-surface/src/components/form';

<Form @model={{this.formModel}} @layout='vertical' @density='comfortable' />
```
Pairs with Form Wizard for multi-step flows.
